source: Oh I am sorry, it seems we could not make the item your require.
target: 啊真抱歉，看来我们无法制作你所要求的装备。
探索模式：无限生命（捐赠者特权）

source:
Channel eldritch forces into a ferocious melee attack, hitting the target three times with your shields doing %d%% Nature damage.
		If any of the attacks hit, the target will be dazed for %d turns and your Block cooldown is reset.
		The chance for the attack to daze increases with you Physical Power, but it is considered a magical attack and thus is resisted with spell save, rather than physical save.
target:
调用奥术能量，激发近战攻击，用盾牌攻击目标三次，造成 %d%% 自然武器伤害。
		只要有一次命中，将眩晕目标 %d 回合，你的格挡技能冷却将会被重置。
		由于这次攻击视为魔法攻击，眩晕成功率由己方物理强度和目标法术豁免（非物理豁免）决定。

source:
During the Age of Haze nearly all gods were destroyed by the Sher'tul Godslayers. However, a small number escaped.
Gerlyk, the creator of the Human race, prefered to flee into the void between the stars than to face death. He has been trapped ever since.
The sorcerers tried to bring him back and nearly succeeded.
Now you have come to finish what the Sher'tul began. Become a Godslayer yourself.
target:
在混沌纪，几乎大部分神祇都被夏·图尔的弑神者所杀。但仍有少部分逃离。
盖里克，人类缔造者，则选择走进群星间的虚空来避免死亡。他从此一直被困在那里。
巫师们曾试图将他召回，并且险些成功。
现在是你结束夏·图尔人未完成事业的时刻了，去成为一名弑神者吧。

source: It is a ghostly nightmare of an entity.
#LIGHT_BLUE#You feel the whisper of your ancestors as you wield this pickaxe!
target: #LIGHT_BLUE#当你挥舞这把十字镐时，你仿佛听到了先祖的低语！

source: A massive hole in the Sunwall.
target: 太阳堡垒上有一个巨大的孔洞。

deep_observation: 限定语被改成唯一最高级。源文 one of the greatest orcs ever to live 是「最伟大兽人之一」，译文「迄今为止最伟大的兽人」丢掉「之一」。证据：engine@624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，game/modules/tome/data/general/objects/boss-artifacts-maj-eyal.lua:513 原文即 one of the greatest；同版本 game/modules/tome/data/lore/orc-prides.lua:140 才用无限定的 Garkul was the greatest orc to ever live（兽人自述口吻），两处措辞刻意区分，译文抹平了这一差别。另 great helm 的 great（盔型：巨盔/桶盔）整体丢失，同文件 511-512 行 unided_name=tribal helm、name=Steel Helm of Garkul 表明这是具体盔型而非泛称「头盔」。
source: A great helm that belonged to Garkul the Devourer, one of the greatest orcs ever to live.
surface_observation: 原文“one of the greatest orcs ever to live”中的“之一”被省略，译文变成“迄今为止最伟大的兽人”。
target: 这是迄今为止最伟大的兽人，吞噬者加库尔的头盔。

source: This young orc is almost fully formed, with hard muscles prominently visible beneath its thick skin. Whilst it has lost some of the wild energy of its younger siblings you can see the gleams of intelligence and cold calculation behind its dark eyes.
target: 这只年轻兽人已近乎成年，厚实的皮肤下肌肉贲张。虽然它已不像年幼的同类那样野性十足，但你能从它漆黑的双眼背后看到智慧与冷酷算计的光芒。

source: #LIGHT_BLUE#You go back in time to rewrite history!
While other races are stuck in their belief that arcane forces and natural forces are meant to oppose, dwarves have found a way to combine them in harmony.
target: 在其他种族受困于自然和魔法天生对立的偏见时，矮人们已经找到方法让这两种力量和谐共存。

source:
Lay a pressure triggered trap that collapses the ground under the target, dealing %0.2f physical damage while burying them (removing from combat) for 5 turns.
Victims may resist being buried, in which case they are pinned (ignores 50%% pin immunity) instead.
target:
放置一个压力感应陷阱，目标经过时地面将坍塌，造成 %0.2f 物理伤害并将其埋在地下（暂时移出游戏）5 回合。
如果目标抵抗被埋，那么他将被定身（无视 50%% 定身免疫）。

source: The magic of the heavens is known to but a few, and that knowledge has long passed east, forgotten.
target: 天空魔法鲜有人知，而那些知识早已东传，被人遗忘。

source: You require a digger to dig.

Whenever you use a non-instant talent you launch a spear of bone at all enemies afflicted by 3 or more magical detrimental effects dealing %d physical damage to all enemies it passes through.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
target:
每当你使用非瞬发技能时，你会朝所有受到 3 个或更多魔法负面效果影响的敌人分别发射骨矛，对骨矛穿过的所有敌人造成 %d 物理伤害。
		伤害随法术强度提高。

source: A thin, dark dagger that seems to meld seamlessly into the shadows.
target: 一把纤细、暗色的匕首，似乎完全融入了阴影之中。

deep_observation: 并列两方被合并成一方，关系出错。源文 rescuing Melinda from Kryl-Feijan and the cultists 中 Kryl-Feijan 与邪教徒是并列的两个施害方：engine@624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，game/modules/tome/data/zones/crypt-kryl-feijan/npcs.lua:28-30 定义 define_as=KRYL_FEIJAN、name=Kryl-Feijan、unique=true 的唯一恶魔 NPC（BASE_NPC_MAJOR_DEMON），同文件 121-122 行另有 define_as=ACOLYTE、name=Acolyte of the Sect of Kryl-Feijan 的教徒杂兵；game/modules/tome/data/quests/kryl-feijan-escape.lua:23 也分述为 a sect worshipping a demon named Kryl-Feijan。译文「从克里尔·费扬邪教手中」把恶魔本体降格为教派名的修饰成分，救出对象里不再包含恶魔本人。
source: After rescuing Melinda from Kryl-Feijan and the cultists you met her again in Last Hope.
surface_observation: 原文将 Kryl-Feijan 与 the cultists 并列为解救对象所受威胁的两方；译文合并成“克里尔·费扬邪教”，把专名与邪教徒误合为一个组织名称。
target: 在你从克里尔·费扬邪教手中解救了梅琳达之后，你在最后的希望又碰到了她。
法杖 紊乱降低异常率

deep_observation: 专有地形限定词 invocation 被略去。engine@624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，game/modules/tome/data/zones/high-peak/grids.lua:130、144、158、172 定义了四处名为 Invocation Portal: Undeath / Elements / Dragons / Destruction 的地形，desc 为 An invocation portal, perpetually summoning beings through it（召唤传送门，持续把生物送进来）；成就正是按关闭这些召唤传送门的数量分档（game/modules/tome/data/quests/high-peak.lua:85-95 统计 closed-portal-demon/dragon/elemental/undead 后按 nb_portal 依次授予 SORCERER_NO/ONE/TWO/THREE/FOUR_PORTAL）。译文只作「传送门」，与游戏内普通传送门无法区分，丢失该成就系列赖以成立的机制限定。
source: Fought the two Sorcerers and closed one invocation portal.
surface_observation: 原文 Fought the two Sorcerers 仅表述与两名巫师交战，译文“杀死2名巫师”增加了原文未陈述的击杀结果。
target: 在关闭1扇传送门的情况下，杀死2名巫师。

source: You can not jump onto a creature.
target: 你不能跳到另一个生物上。

source: Enhanced melee combat through the dark arts.
target: 利用黑暗力量来增强你的近战格斗。

source: The elder points to Reknor on your map, to the north on the western side of the Iron Throne.
target: 长老在你的地图上指出了瑞库纳的位置，在钢铁王座西部边境的北部。

source: Creates a shield of radius %d that redirects all damage done to friends inside it to you for 5 turns.
target: 制造一层半径 %d 的护盾，将友方受到的伤害转移过来，持续 5 回合。
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +0 力量，+1 敏捷，+0 体质

source:
When your effective movement speed (global speed times movement speed) is less than 100%%, reduces all incoming damage by a percent equal to the speed detriment (up to 70%%).
Current reduction bonus: %d%%
target:
当你的有效移动速度（全局速度乘移动速度）小于100%%的时候，降低所有伤害，比例相当于当前移动速度和100%%的差距，但最大不超过70%%。
当前减伤比例：%d%%

source:
Call upon the grace of the Eternals to increase your global speed by %d%% for 5 turns.
		The speed bonus will increase with your Dexterity or Magic (whichever is higher).
target:
召唤不朽的恩赐之力来增加你 %d%% 的全局速度，持续 5 回合。
		受敏捷和魔法中较高一项影响，速度会有额外的提升。

source: #LIGHT_RED#You carefully open the door and enter the underground crypt...
target: #LIGHT_RED#你小心翼翼地打开门，进入了地下的地宫……

source:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#The device seems to be made of pure crystal. It projects a very accurate map of the known world - including the forbidden continent of the south.
There seems to be a hole about the size and form of your Rod of Recall.#WHITE#*
target:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#这个装置似乎完全由水晶制成，里面显现出已知世界的精确地图，包括南部的禁秘大陆。
上面似乎有一个孔洞，其大小和形状都与回归之杖相仿。#WHITE#*

deep_observation: 漏译可核验的装备机制。源文 wielding a massive battle-axe（手持巨大战斧）在译文「一位身穿重甲的精神体狂战士」中完全缺失，只保留了重甲。engine@624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，game/modules/tome/data/talents/psionic/thought-forms.lua:301 该召唤物 body 含 MAINHAND=1，331-332 行 resolvers.equip 首项即 {type=weapon, subtype=battleaxe, autoreq=true, ...}，战斧是强制装备而非修辞；333 行才是 subtype=heavy 的重甲。两件装备在源码中同级并列，译文只保留其一。
source: A thought-forged warrior wielding a massive battle-axe and clad in heavy armor.  It appears ready for battle.
surface_observation: 原文“wielding a massive battle-axe”（手持巨大战斧）在译文中完全遗漏。
target: 一位身穿重甲的精神体狂战士。他时刻准备着战斗。

source:
#GOLD#Lite radius#LAST#
The maximum distance your lite can light up. Anything further cannot be seen by natural means, unless the place itself is lit.
target:
#GOLD#光照范围#LAST#
你的灯具可照亮的最大距离。任何在光照范围之外的区域，除非被预先照亮，否则正常情况下无法看见里面的东西。

source: Pins non spiderkin for %d turns. Decays over time.
target: 定身所有非蜘蛛族 %d 回合。会随时间消失。

source:
Allows you to wield a physical melee or ranged weapon, a mindstar or a gem telekinetically, gaining a special effect for each.
		A gem will provide a +3 bonus to all primary stats per tier of the gem.
		A mindstar will randomly try to telekinetically grab a far away foe (10% chance and range 3 for a tier 1 mindstar, +1 range and +5% chance for each tier above 1) and pull it into melee range.
		A physical melee weapon will act as a semi independant entity, automatically attacking adjacent foes each turn, while a ranged weapon will fire at your target whenever you perform a ranged attack.
		While this talent is active, all melee and ranged attacks use 60% of your Cunning and Willpower in place of Dexterity and Strength for accuracy and damage calculations respectively.
target:
允许你用念力装备一件物理近战或远程武器、灵晶或宝石，不同物品会获得不同效果。
		宝石：每一级材质等级使所有主要属性增加 3 点。
		灵晶：一级材质时有 10% 几率抓取 3 格内的远处敌人；材质等级每提高一级，范围增加 1 格、几率增加 5%，并将其拉入近战范围。
		物理近战武器：作为半独立实体，每回合自动攻击相邻敌人；远程武器：每当你发动远程攻击时，自动射击你的目标。
		激活时，所有近战和远程攻击在计算命中与伤害时，分别以 60% 灵巧替代敏捷、以 60% 意志替代力量。

source: Thanks, my lady, that is all of them. I will look for the tunnel and venture inside the Peak.
target: 谢谢你，我的女士，看来我已经集齐了所有的水晶球。我会寻找史莱姆通道，打开通向巅峰的道路。

source:
Stolen flesh,
	Stolen pain,
	To give it up,
	Is to live again.
target:
窃取血肉，
	窃取苦痛，
	舍弃本我，
	秽尸复苏。

deep_observation: 力量体系归类错误且因果关系丢失。engine@624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，该载入提示（game/modules/tome/init.lua:100）配图为 humanoid_human_ben_cruthdar__the_cursed，指向被诅咒者（Cursed）职业；game/modules/tome/data/birth/classes/afflicted.lua:61 该职业 power_source={psionic=true, technique=true}，属精神/灵能系，译文把 mental powers 作「灵魂力量」，归入了游戏中另有所指的灵魂体系。其次 powered by hatred 是「以憎恨为动力来源」的因果表述（同文件 52 行 Their only master now is the hatred they carry for every living thing），译文「终其一生都活在憎恨和黑暗中」改为状态描写，驱动关系消失；beyond their full control 的 full（并非完全失控）亦被略去，译作「超出他们控制」。
source: Some are cursed with mental powers beyond their full control, turning them to a dark life powered by hatred.
surface_observation: 原文“mental powers”（精神力量）被译为“灵魂力量”，改变了力量的性质。
target: 某些被诅咒者承受了超出他们控制的灵魂力量，终其一生都活在憎恨和黑暗中。

source: Learn to fasten your foes way into the grave.
target: 加速你的敌人走向死亡的过程。

source: You gain %0.2f gold from the transmogrification of %s.
I've been known to kill the occasional monster. Is there a reward in it for me?
target: 我偶尔也会杀杀怪物。这对我有什么报酬？
